title: COME Holy Spirit | Walking In The Holy Spirit (Christian Motivation)
paragraphs: imagine being handed a jigsaw puzzle without the picture on the box you have all those pieces and no clear idea of what you're supposed to be building you know they fit together somehow to make something beautiful but without the picture where do you even start life can feel a lot like that puzzle sometimes we have all these pieces decisions relationships challenges and dreams and we know they're supposed to fit together but how we look at all the pieces and wonder what's

the big picture here in the Bible there's a story about a man named bezalel his name may sound unfamiliar but don't worry we are also here to help you to study the Scriptures Daily now back to the man named bezalel in Exodus 31. verses one to five the Bible says then the Lord spoke to Moses saying see I have called by name bezalel the son of ayuri the son of her of the tribe of Judah and I have filled him with

the spirit of God in wisdom in understanding and knowledge and in all manner of workmanship to design artistic Works to work in gold in silver in bronze and cutting Jewels for setting and carving wood and to work in all manner of workmanship so bezalel was given the enormous task of crafting the Tabernacle a place where God's presence would dwell among the people it was like a massive puzzle with many pieces but note God didn't just hand the pieces to bezalel and

walk away he filled him with his Spirit giving him wisdom understanding and skill the Holy Spirit was like the picture on the puzzle box for bezalel guiding him and putting together something incredibly complex and beautiful and just like with bezalel the Holy Spirit wants to guide us too you see the Bible is like our road map for how to live but sometimes even with the Bible in our hands we need help fitting the pieces together we need guidance on how to

apply those instructions to our unique and complex lives that's where the Holy Spirit comes in like a trusted friend sitting beside us helping us find the right peace at the right time he guides Us in understanding and applying the Bible's wisdom to our daily lives understanding and walking in the Holy Spirit is essential because he helps us see the big picture of our lives and fits the pieces together in the way that God intended without him we are like someone trying

to solve a puzzle without the picture with him we can create something beautiful and purposeful so today we're going to explore what it means to walk in the Holy Spirit and how to recognize his guidance how to allow him to help us put together the beautiful puzzle that is our life using the ultimate instruction manual the word of God if you've ever felt like you need a helping hand with life's puzzle this message is for you now who is the Holy

Spirit the person of the holy spirit is not just a force but a person who can be known and interacted with have you ever talked to someone on the phone who you've never met in person you can hear their voice and understand their words but without seeing them it's hard to know them fully many of us think of the Holy Spirit like that a voice or a feeling but not someone we can really know but the holy spirit is not just

a force or a distant voice he's a person we can know and interact with just like a close friend in the Bible there's a story about a couple named ananias and Sapphira in the book of Acts chapter 5 verses 1 to 11 they lied to the Holy Spirit treating him as if he were just a rule or a force not a person who knows our hearts Peter told them in Acts 5. verse 4. you have not lied to men but to

God showing that the holy spirit is indeed God knowing and understanding everything about us understanding that the holy spirit is a person who loves guides and interacts with us changes everything it means we can have a relationship with him we can talk to him listen to him and even feel his presence in our lives he's not just an idea or a Feeling he's a real person who wants to be involved in our everyday lives one of the most amazing and unique

things about God is that he is three in one Father Son and Holy Spirit this is often called the Trinity and it's like a perfect team working together in Perfect Harmony imagine a three-legged stool each leg supports the stool and all three legs are necessary for it to stand the Trinity is like that stool with each part Father Son and Holy Spirit playing a unique role and all three working together perfectly the account of the baptism of Jesus in Matthew 3.

verses 16 to 17. gives us a beautiful picture of the Trinity the Bible says when he had been baptized Jesus came up immediately from the water and behold the heavens were opened to him and he saw the spirit of God descending like a dove and a lighting upon him and suddenly a voice Came From Heaven saying this is my beloved Son in whom I am well pleased the holy spirit's place in the trinity shows us that he is not less than

the father or the son but equal working together with them in everything it's a profound mystery but it's also a beautiful picture of how God relates to us just as the father loves us and sent his son to save us the holy spirit is here with us now guiding teaching comforting and empowering us he is a part of the perfect love and perfect plan of God for our lives so the holy spirit is not just a force or an idea he

is a person part of the wonderful Trinity of God and he wants to be known and interacted with by us today let's open our hearts to him get to know him better and allow him to work in our lives in powerful ways through him we can experience God's love and presence like never before now what are the roles of the Holy Spirit the Holy Spirit has several roles in our lives number one he is our comforter and counselor John 14 verse

26 tells us but the comforter which is the Holy Ghost whom the father will send in my name he shall teach you all things and bring all things to your remembrance whatsoever I have said unto you therefore the holy spirit is a source of comfort and wisdom in life storms we all need someone who truly understands and cares the holy spirit is that friend for us always present to give consolation but he's not just there to provide Comfort he's also a

counselor when we Face challenging decisions he offers wisdom and guidance much like a dear friend advising Us in times of uncertainty number two he is the convictor of sin guiding Us in righteousness and convicting us of wrongdoings John 16 verse 8 says and when he has come he will convict the world of sin and of righteousness and of judgment just as a loving parent corrects a child the Holy Spirit tells us when we're on the wrong path he's not there to

condemn but to guide us back as seen in the story of Nathan the prophet helping King David recognize his sin this story can be found in second Samuel 12. verses 1 to 14. number three he is our guide and teacher leading us into all truth and helping us understand God's word in John 16 verse 13. the scripture reminds us however when he the spirit of Truth has come he will guide you into all truth for he will not speak on his

own authority but whatever he hears he will speak and he will tell you things to come the truth is Understanding God's word can feel like a maze sometimes but the holy spirit is our guide and teacher he leads us into truth and Clarity just as he led Philip in Acts 8 verses 26 to 35 to explain the scriptures to the Ethiopian eunuch number four he empowers and enables us therefore equipping us with strength and spiritual gifts for service the Holy Spirit

also acts as our coach empowering us with the strength and abilities we need to serve God effectively this power is not just physical but includes spiritual gifts acts 1 verse 8 assures us but you shall receive power when the Holy Spirit has come upon you and rule number five he seals us by protecting and assuring us of our Salvation imagine a letter sealed with wax unbroken and secure in a similar way the Holy Spirit seals us this ceiling is more than

just a Mark it's a promise a guarantee of our Salvation the story of Noah's Ark can help to illustrate this ceiling in Genesis chapter 6 to 9 just as the ark was sealed to protect those inside the Holy Spirit seals us keeping us safe in Christ Paul also writes about this in Ephesians 1 verses 13 to 14 explaining that the holy spirit is the guarantee of our inheritance the Bible says in him you also trusted after you heard the word of

Truth the gospel of your salvation in whom also having believed you were sealed with the Holy Spirit of promise who is the guarantee of our inheritance until the Redemption of the purchased possession to the praise of his glory so he's our assurance a constant reminder that we belong to God and that our Salvation is secure the holy spirit's roles are indeed varied and profound each role is a representation of his love wisdom and power working in our lives let's Embrace his

work within us trusting him in every aspect of Our Lives with the Holy Spirit we have a friend a guide a teacher and a protector equipping us for fulfilling our sealed life in Christ now walking in the holy spirit means surrender and submission it starts with a simple but powerful Act surrender it's about yielding ourselves fully to the spirit's control imagine a child holding their parents hand trusting them to lead the way in the same way we need to hold the

holy spirit's hand trusting him completely King Solomon's request for wisdom is a wonderful example of surrender in First Kings 3 verse 9. he didn't ask for wealth or power but for an understanding heart this submission to God's will allowed him to rule wisely yielding ourselves to the spirit means letting him take control of Our Lives We Trust his leading his timing his way and it brings peace and purpose into our lives walking in the spirit also involves recognizing the spirit's guidance

it's about learning to recognize when the spirit is speaking to us do you ever wonder if the holy spirit is speaking to you learning to recognize his voice takes practice and attention consider Samuel a young boy who didn't recognize God's voice at first in the book of First Samuel 3 verses 1 to 10. with Eli's guidance Samuel learned to listen and respond and he said speak for your servant hears we too can learn to recognize the spirit's guidance it often comes

as a gentle nudge a strong conviction or an unexplainable peace with practice we become more attuned to recognize his voice in our lives and also walking in the spirit is about living a Spirit-filled life I am talking about living in alignment with the spirit daily producing the fruit of the spirit according to Galatians 5 verses 22 to 23. but the fruit of the spirit is love joy peace long-suffering kindness goodness faithfulness gentleness self-control against such there is no law a Spirit-filled

life is full of fruits but it's not something we can grow on our own it comes from daily living in alignment with the spirit think about Joseph who faced betrayal slavery and imprisonment in Genesis chapters 39-41 yet he remained faithful and full of Integrity showing the fruits of the spirit in his life we too can live this way blossoming as we walk daily with the Holy Spirit when we begin to walk in the spirit we will also be led by the

Holy Spirit we should all have that desire for the spirits leading cultivating a heart that earnestly seeks the spirit's Direction being led by the Holy Spirit starts with a genuine desire to follow him we must want his guidance more than anything else we also need to practice sensitivity to the spirit this means growing in our ability to discern the spirits leading this is like tuning a radio to the right station it takes careful attention and practice the story of Elijah hearing

God's voice in a gentle whisper in First Kings 19 verse 11 to 13 reminds us that the spirit often speaks Softly we need to practice listening tuning Our Hearts to hear his gentle guidance responding to the spirit's promptings is also important this is about taking steps of obedience When the Spirit guides when we know the spirit is guiding us we must respond taking steps of obedience shows our faith and trust consider ananias who obeyed the spirits prompting to visit Saul a

known persecutor of Christians in Acts 9 verses 10 to 18. his obedience played a vital role in Saul's conversion to Paul the Apostle we too can make a significant impact by responding to the spirit's promptings and when it comes to being led by the spirit we really want to avoid quenching the spirit I'm talking about being aware of attitudes and actions that can hinder the spirit's work first Thessalonians 5 19 says quench not the spirit so we must avoid anything that

might block or quench the spirit's work in our lives think of quenching like putting out a fire certain attitudes and actions can dampen the spirit's influence in Jonah chapters one to three the story of Jonah running away from God's call is a vivid example his resistance quenched the spirit's leading until he repented we must be aware of our attitudes and be willing to let go of anything that might hinder the spirit's work in US attitudes that can hinder the spirit's work

in our lives includes unbelief and doubt Pride Disobedience unforgiveness and bitterness fear stubbornness and resistance worldliness and materialism as well as chronic negativity and complaining therefore walking in the Holy Spirit and being led by him are vital aspects of the Christian Life may we open our hearts to the spirit's guidance live daily in his presence and respond to his leading knowing that he is our comforter teacher guide and much more let's take these steps together walking hand in hand with the

spirit each day experiencing the fullness of life that God has for us now let's look at the transforming power of the spirit the Holy Spirit changes us from the inside out he is like a skilled artist working inside us molding us into the image of Christ just like clay in The Potter's hands we are shaped by the spirit's touch remember the transformation of Zacchaeus the tax collector in Luke 19 verses 1 to 10. his Encounter With Jesus led to a profound

change in his life the Holy Spirit wants to do the same in us taking away our old ways and giving us new life in Philippians 1 verse 6 the Bible says he who has begun a good work in you will complete it until the day of Jesus Christ the Holy Spirit also empowers us for Ministry he fills us with power to serve others think of Gideon a timid man whom God transformed into a brave leader we find historian judges chapters six

to seven the spirit empowered him to lead a small Army to victory you don't have to be a hero or a saint for the spirit to use you he equips regular people like you and me for his work whether it's helping a neighbor or sharing God's love with a family or friend the spirit gives us what we need in Acts 1 verse 8 the scripture says but you shall receive power when the Holy Spirit has come upon you and you shall

be witnesses to me in Jerusalem and in all Judea and Samaria and to the end of the Earth we must embrace our dependence on the spirit recognizing our need for the spirit's guidance in every aspect of life living in the spirit means leaning on him just like a child leans on a parent we can't do it on our own King jehoshaphat's prayer for guidance when faced with a vast Army shows how we too should depend on the spirit we can ask

him for help in every part of our lives from Big challenges to small daily choices for in him we live and move and have our being according to acts 17 verse 28 as we walk in the spirit we should integrate the spirits leading in our decision making so how do you do this you start applying the spirit's guidance in Practical everyday decisions do you ever wonder what to do in your daily life the Holy Spirit wants to help with that too

in the book of Acts chapter 6 verses one to seven we see where the early church relied on the spirit's guidance in choosing Deacons when faced with the task of Distributing food to the widows the spirit can guide our everyday decisions helping us to Choose Wisely and to live in a way that pleases God Proverbs 3 Verse 6 says in all your ways acknowledge Him and He Shall direct your paths fostering a deeper relationship with the spirit is also important engaging

in practices that deepen our connection with the spirit such as daily prayer and meditation on scripture helps us to grow closer to the spirit the holy spirit's work in our lives fills us with joy and purpose he changes us helps us guides us and draws us closer to God growing closer to the spirit takes time and effort God says be still and know that I am God when we walk in the Holy Spirit Our Lives become beautiful filled with love joy

peace and hope a life led by the spirit is not a dull or ordinary life it's an adventure filled with wonder and excitement and it's available to everyone let the Holy Spirit be the first one you talk to each day the first one you listen to you'll find it makes all the difference in your day and in your life have you ever received an invitation to a grand party or an exciting event today you're invited to the greatest journey of all

a lifelong walk with the Holy Spirit remember the story of Naaman in Second Kings 5 verses 1 to 14. Naaman was the commander who was healed of leprosy after following Elisha's instruction to wash in the Jordan River this is a great reminder that sometimes the Journey of the spirit requires simple obedience and faith and the results are miraculous the invitation is here and now it's not just for a Chosen Few but for everyone who desires a deeper richer relationship with God

this journey with the Holy Spirit is like finding a precious treasure and it's yours to discover you too can experience the wonders of walking with the spirit it's a journey that starts with a single step a step of surrender faith and commitment so why not take that step today the adventure of a lifetime is waiting for you and the rewards are eternal trust in the Lord with all your heart and lean not on your own understanding in all your ways acknowledge

Him and He Shall direct your paths now to all those within the sound of my voice let us go to the Lord in prayer I want you to pray this prayer with me so that you can have all the blessings of this prayer let us pray to our gracious and loving God Heavenly Father I praise you for your Mighty power and unending love I glorify your name and thank you for the gift of the Holy Spirit Lord I invite the Holy

Spirit to fill me lead me and transform me every day I choose to walk in alignment with the spirit to hear your voice and follow your path father in the name of Jesus I rebuke anything that may hinder my walk with the Holy Spirit I Cast Away doubt fear confusion and anything that does not align with your perfect will for me I declare in the name of Jesus a life filled with the fruits of the spirit and righteousness let your Holy

Spirit be my constant guide my comforter my strength and my teacher Heavenly Father I praise you for your kindness and for blessing me beyond measure I glorify your name knowing that every good gift comes from you in the name of Jesus I declare your guidance and wisdom over my life I declare healing over my body mind and soul I invite your Holy Spirit to renew and restore me to breathe life into every part that needs your touch Lord I also pray

for your Divine protection Lord I rebuke any harm danger or negativity that may come my way in the name of Jesus father I ask for your Shield to surround me and my loved ones keeping us safe in your care may you bless our coming in and going out Lord I ask for an abundance of your grace to flow in and through our lives father may we always be aware of your presence and open to the many ways you bless us each

day as I say this prayer together with everyone listening I pray for the hearts of those who will hear this message that they may be touched inspired and drawn closer to you let this message be a blessing a call to action and a beautiful invitation to walk in the spirit in the mighty name of Jesus I pray amen if you were blessed by this message type the word amen in the comments section below you can help us to reach more persons

and spread the gospel you can do this by sharing the video with a friend or family member and by clicking the like button also remember to subscribe to the channel for more videos that will bless your heart and uplift your spirit we appreciate all your support you're blessed to be a blessing please feel free to leave your prayer request in the comments section so that we can present them before God for your blessings and victory and we also invite other believers

on the YouTube platform and all over the world to join us and start praying for you right now to God be all the glory I declare that all the blessings of this prayer are now upon you in the name of Jesus May the grace and peace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with you all thank you
